statement: Linux builds DualSense output report 0x02 on USB and 0x31 on Bluetooth; a common 47-byte effects block contains rumble, audio routing, mic, power-save and lightbar/player LED controls. Bluetooth adds sequence/header fields and CRC.

applicability.revision: source revisions: Linux 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b, HHD adbd50f, virtualgamepad archive a5310c6; physical firmware/revision not measured
applicability.scope: hid-playstation.c 269-316, 1251-1319. The source describes a kernel consumer, not physical sound, light or motor actuation.
